items.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Sonnet 5
items.summary: Anthropic calls Claude Sonnet 5 its most agentic Sonnet model and says it performs close to Opus 4.8 at a lower price. It became the default for Free and Pro users, with API pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens, which an August edit to the post made permanent.
